en.headline: Two Belvedere Garden blocks lose power for nearly three hours
en.dek: Blocks 5 and 6 in Tsuen Wan suffered an outage from about 9 p.m. Thursday that cut air-conditioning and lighting; CLP restored supply around midnight as residents gathered downstairs to escape the heat.

zh.headline: 荃灣麗城花園兩座停電近三小時 居民下樓避暑
zh.dek: 第5座及第6座周四晚約9時停電，冷氣及照明受影響，中電至約午夜復電；不少居民因室內酷熱下樓透氣。

en.headline: Woman in 60s dies after being pulled from sea off Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Marine police rescued the unconscious woman about 20 metres from shore near Belvedere Garden around midnight; she was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital after prolonged resuscitation.

zh.headline: 荃灣海面救起60多歲女子 送院後不治
zh.dek: 水警於周五凌晨在麗城花園對開約20米海面救起昏迷女子，送仁濟醫院搶救後證實死亡。

en.headline: 44-year-old truck driver dies after collapsing at wheel in Tsing Yi
en.dek: Police said the medium goods vehicle driver lost consciousness while travelling towards Tsuen Wan on Thursday evening; the vehicle hit a kerb and he was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital.

zh.headline: 青衣44歲貨車司機駕駛期間暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方指事主周四晚駕駛中型貨車沿青衣路往荃灣方向行駛時失去知覺，車輛失控撞壆，送仁濟醫院後證實死亡。

en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning issued; Thunderstorm Warning extended to 11 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 8.40 a.m. Friday as heavy rain fell or was expected, and extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 11 a.m. with squally storms.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨警告生效 雷暴警告延至上午11時
zh.dek: 天文台周五上午8時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，指本港已有或預料會有超過每小時30毫米的大雨，並將雷暴警告延長至上午11時。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 8:45 a.m. with squally storms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has extended the Thunderstorm Warning issued at 4:45 a.m. until 8:45 a.m. Friday, expecting a few squally thunderstorms over Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延至上午8時45分 局部地區有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台將今早4時45分發出的雷暴警告延長至周五上午8時45分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Re-Love Festival shifts to Vintage Revival theme at The Mills this weekend
en.dek: The second weekend of the Re-Love Festival at The Mills in Tsuen Wan opens today with a Vintage Revival programme featuring markets, classic cars and 1960s–1980s style.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠Re-Love綠續生活節本周末轉入古著文化祭
zh.dek: 荃灣南豐紗廠Re-Love綠續生活節第二周末由今日起以「古著文化祭」為主題，包括市集、老爺車及六十至八十年代風格活動。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 3:30 a.m. with isolated squally storms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has issued a Thunderstorm Warning effective until 3:30 a.m. Friday, expecting isolated squally thunderstorms across the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至凌晨3時30分 局部地區有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台發出雷暴警告，有效至周五凌晨3時30分，預料本港有局部地區出現狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Kowloon Tong records highest Aedes mosquito index in latest FEHD survey
en.dek: Eleven of 16 surveyed areas reached Level 2, indicating fairly extensive distribution of Aedes albopictus; the department issued three prosecutions and multiple statutory notices over breeding sites.

zh.headline: 八月第二批白紋伊蚊指數 九龍塘最高達16.7% 食環提三宗檢控
zh.dek: 16個監察地區中有11區屬第二級別，顯示白紋伊蚊分布頗為廣泛；東區及九龍城發現滋生地點並採取執法行動。

en.headline: CK Hutchison first-half profit surges more than 30-fold on asset sales
en.dek: Reported profit attributable to shareholders reached HK$26.8 billion, driven by gains from UK infrastructure disposals; underlying profit rose about 7 per cent and the interim dividend increased 5 per cent.

zh.headline: 長和上半年純利飆升逾30倍至268億元 派中期息0.7455元
zh.dek: 主要受惠出售英國基建資產收益，基本溢利升約7%；中期息按年增加5%，淨負債比率降至歷史低位。

en.headline: McDonald’s Hong Kong suspends shrimp burgers after Taiwan finds banned antibiotic
en.dek: The local operator said its shrimp patties come from a different Thai production batch and recipe, but paused sales of the Ebi range as a precaution to address public concern.

zh.headline: 台麥當勞蝦堡驗出禁用抗生素 港方預防性停售滋味蝦堡系列
zh.dek: 香港麥當勞指本地蝦餅配方及批次與台灣不同，為釋除公眾疑慮即時暫停出售相關產品。

en.headline: Public housing waiting time edges up to 4.8 years in latest quarter
en.dek: The Housing Bureau said the slight rise reflects more long-waiting applicants being housed in popular urban and extended urban units; the target remains 4.5 years by 2026/27.

zh.headline: 公屋綜合輪候時間微升至4.8年 房屋局指仍向4.5年目標邁進
zh.dek: 房屋局公布截至6月底綜合輪候時間4.8年，較上季升0.1年，仍低於5年；目標維持2026/27年度回落至4.5年。

en.headline: Around 1,000 civil servants take part in first large Huanggang Port transport drill
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the stress test of the public transport interchange went smoothly and officials noted areas for improvement such as signage and queue control.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸逾千公務員參與公共運輸壓力測試 鄧炳強指順利
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示演練安排周密、過程順利，已識別指示牌及排隊管理等可改進範疇。

en.headline: MTR first-half profit more than doubles to HK$15.87 billion on property gains
en.dek: Strong contributions from Tai Wai Station and Southside Package 5 projects lifted property development profit by 120.7 per cent; interim dividend held at 42 cents.

zh.headline: 港鐵上半年盈利倍增至158.7億元 物業發展收益大增
zh.dek: 大圍站及黃竹坑南港島線第五期項目帶動物業發展溢利升120.7%；中期息維持每股0.42元。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning cancelled after nine consecutive hot days
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory lifted the warning at 7.20pm on Thursday as temperatures eased; the city had recorded highs of 33 degrees Celsius or above for nine days running.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告晚上取消 連續九日最高溫33度或以上
zh.dek: 天文台周四晚上7時20分取消酷熱天氣警告；本港連續九日錄得最高氣溫33度或以上，平八月最長紀錄。

en.headline: Hysan first-half underlying profit rises 7.4% on residential sales gains
en.dek: The Causeway Bay landlord reported underlying profit of HK$1.11 billion and declared an unchanged first interim dividend of 27 cents per share.

zh.headline: 希慎上半年基本溢利升7.4% 派中期息27仙
zh.dek: 受惠出售竹林苑住宅單位公平值收益，基本溢利11.07億元，第一次中期息維持每股27仙。

en.headline: Food Expo opens at Wan Chai convention centre with queues for bargains
en.dek: The five-day event and four companion fairs drew more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 places; Financial Secretary Paul Chan said mega events are expected to bring HK$12 billion in spending.

zh.headline: 美食博覽灣仔會展開鑼 市民清晨排隊搶購
zh.dek: 連同四個同期展覽共逾1850家展商參與，財爺陳茂波指大型活動料帶來120億元消費。

en.headline: Labour Department bars security firm from imported labour applications for two years
en.dek: Jiawei Security Services was sanctioned for altering recruitment conditions without approval, rejecting qualified local applicants and submitting false interview records under the Supplementary Labour Scheme.

zh.headline: 佳衛保安違規拒聘本地求職者 勞工處禁申外勞兩年
zh.dek: 公司在補充勞工優化計劃下未獲同意改招聘條件、無理拒聘合資格者及提交失實面試資料，遭即時中止申請及兩年禁令。

en.headline: Three mainland scientists win 2026 Future Science Prize in Hong Kong
en.dek: Innovation Secretary Sun Dong said the prize has cemented its status as a premier scientific event in the city after four consecutive years hosted here.

zh.headline: 三名內地科學家獲2026未來科學大獎 孫東指鞏固香港創科地位
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，大獎連續四年在港舉行，已確立為本港首屈一指的科學盛事。

en.headline: Tsuen Wan street shops to trial dedicated food-waste collection points from September
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department will set up three new collection points serving more than 100 shops selling meat, fruit, vegetables and fish, with bins open daily from 9am to 9pm.

zh.headline: 荃灣街舖九月試行廚餘回收點 覆蓋逾百間肉菜魚檔
zh.dek: 環保署將在川龍街、河背街一帶增設三個回收點，每日上午9時至晚上9時開放，服務逾100間街舖。

en.headline: Elderly pedestrian critically injured after private minibus collision in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: A 75-year-old man was knocked down at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Mei Sin Tong Road around 10am and taken unconscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital; the driver remained at the scene.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣私家小巴撞倒七旬途人 重傷昏迷送院
zh.dek: 75歲男子周四上午約10時在落山道與美善同道交界被撞倒昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院搶救；小巴男司機在場協助調查。

en.headline: Competition Commission mounts second-round raids in building maintenance bid-rigging probe
en.dek: Officers searched 12 premises including four contractors’ offices and residences over suspected cartel conduct affecting 28 estates and buildings with contracts worth about HK$500 million.

zh.headline: 競委會樓宇維修圍標案第二輪執法 涉28屋苑約5億元
zh.dek: 競委會周三根據法庭手令搜查12個處所，包括4間工程承辦商辦公室及涉案人士住所，懷疑違反《競爭條例》第一行為守則。

en.headline: Tesla hits pedestrian in Mong Kok after series of lane changes
en.dek: A 59-year-old woman suffered limb and buttock injuries and was taken conscious to Kwong Wah Hospital; the 52-year-old driver passed a breath test and was not arrested.

zh.headline: 旺角Tesla連切線轉彎撞傷女途人
zh.dek: 59歲姓冼女途人手腳及臀部受傷，清醒送廣華醫院；52歲姓陳男司機通過酒精測試，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: 82-year-old man dies after being pulled from water at Wu Kai Sha pier
en.dek: The man, surnamed Chan, was found unconscious by other swimmers around 4pm on Wednesday and was later certified dead at Prince of Wales Hospital; a post-mortem examination is pending.

zh.headline: 烏溪沙碼頭82歲男子遇溺不治
zh.dek: 男子周三下午約4時被其他泳客發現昏迷，送往威爾斯親王醫院後證實死亡，死因有待剖驗確定。

en.headline: Two mainland men jailed 10 months for 190,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes at airport
en.dek: Customs seized the cigarettes, with a market value of about HK$850,000, from the personal baggage of passengers arriving from Vientiane via Hanoi; the sentences were handed down at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts.

zh.headline: 兩內地男攜19萬支未完稅香煙抵港 同判囚10個月
zh.dek: 海關在機場兩名由老撾經河內抵港旅客的個人行李檢獲合共約19萬支未完稅香煙，市值約85萬元；西九龍裁判法院周三判處各人監禁10個月。

en.headline: Baby Basic recalls pasta and congee products after rice weevil reports
en.dek: The local baby-food maker has withdrawn several instant products from shelves as a precaution and suspended production of three pasta varieties; government tests have not confirmed a health risk.

zh.headline: 寶寶百味回收米形麵及粥品 疑有穀牛
zh.dek: 本地嬰幼兒食品商周三自願下架多款即食產品並暫停三款米形麵生產，作為預防措施；政府化驗未證實健康風險。

en.headline: Chu Hai College finance director remanded over alleged HK$41m theft
en.dek: Ray Yip Kam-chun appeared in Tuen Mun Court on Wednesday facing a theft charge; his wife and an engineering contractor were also denied bail on money-laundering counts.

zh.headline: 珠海學院財務總監涉盜竊4100萬 還押候訊
zh.dek: 葉錦真周三在屯門裁判法院提堂，被控盜竊罪；妻子及一名工程商亦因清洗黑錢罪名不准保釋。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as heat eases only slightly
en.dek: The Observatory expects sunny periods and one or two showers on Thursday, with urban highs around 34 degrees Celsius and continued very hot conditions across the territory.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱稍為緩和
zh.dek: 天文台預料星期四部分時間有陽光及一兩陣驟雨，市區最高氣溫約34度，本港天氣仍然酷熱。

en.headline: Police arrest 80-year-old man after community nurse reports indecent assault
en.dek: Yan Chai Hospital said a community nurse was allegedly assaulted during home visits on 31 July and 4 August; the hospital has zero tolerance for such behaviour and is supporting the staff member.

zh.headline: 仁濟社康護士外出探訪疑被非禮 警拘80歲男子
zh.dek: 院方指一名社康護士於7月31日及8月4日探訪期間懷疑被非禮，接報後報警，警方其後拘捕一名80歲男子。

en.headline: Snooker star Jimmy White becomes Hong Kong resident via talent scheme
en.dek: The English player known as ‘The Whirlwind’ obtained his identity card through the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme and said he plans to open a snooker academy in the city.

zh.headline: 桌球名將占美韋德成香港居民 擬開桌球學院
zh.dek: 有「白旋風」之稱的英國桌球手透過優秀人才入境計劃取得香港身份證，表示計劃在港開設桌球學校培育本地人才。

en.headline: Government begins first phase of Bishop Hill clearance
en.dek: Authorities started removing unauthorised structures and facilities on the Sham Shui Po hillside today, sealing one side for about three days while keeping access open via the other entrance.

zh.headline: 政府展開主教山首階段清場
zh.dek: 當局今日開始清理深水埗窩仔山違法及不安全構築物，首階段圍封棠蔭街一邊約三日，另一邊入口仍可供市民上山。

en.headline: CFS finds excessive aflatoxin in bottled pistachio paste, orders recall
en.dek: A sample of Naturalam 100% Pure Pistachio Butter sold at Sogo contained 12 times the legal limit; the public is advised not to consume the affected batch.

zh.headline: 食安中心驗出開心果醬黃曲霉毒素超標 指令下架回收
zh.dek: 天然之林純開心果醬樣本每公斤含120微克黃曲霉毒素，超法定上限11倍，市民應停止食用受影響批次。

en.headline: Government launches consultation on Building Management Ordinance reforms
en.dek: Proposals include higher attendance and voting thresholds for large-scale works, limits on proxy votes, and stronger powers for the authority; views are invited until 11 September.

zh.headline: 政府就《建築物管理條例》修訂展開公眾諮詢
zh.dek: 建議提高大型維修及大額採購的出席和投票門檻、限制授權票數量，並加強主管當局權力，諮詢期至9月11日。

en.headline: 17-month-old girl in critical condition with influenza A, pneumonia and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection reported another severe paediatric case; the previously healthy toddler remains in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 17個月大女嬰染甲流併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布再有兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，女嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情況危殆。

en.headline: Tour bus driver dies after collapsing in Shing Mun Tunnel; 47 children unhurt
en.dek: A 71-year-old driver lost consciousness while ferrying schoolchildren from Sha Tin toward Tsuen Wan; the vehicle struck a barrier and he later died in hospital.

zh.headline: 城門隧道旅遊巴司機昏迷撞壆後不治 車上47名幼童無恙
zh.dek: 71歲男司機下午載學童由沙田往荃灣方向駛經城門隧道時突然失去知覺，旅遊巴撞向路壆，司機送院後不治，車上幼童全部無受傷。

en.headline: Galaxy Entertainment first-half profit edges up on Macau tourism recovery
en.dek: Net profit rose 0.8 per cent to HK$5.28 billion while revenue increased 4.2 per cent; the group declared an interim dividend of HK$0.90 per share.

zh.headline: 銀河娛樂上半年盈利微升0.8% 派中期息0.9元
zh.dek: 受澳門旅客回升帶動，集團錄得淨利潤52.8億元，收入升4.2%；董事會宣佈派發中期股息每股0.9港元。

en.headline: CHP to end free hepatitis A vaccine for MSM from 12 September
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the transmission chain linked to a cluster among men who have sex with men has been interrupted and cases have returned to baseline levels.

zh.headline: 男男性接觸者免費甲肝疫苗接種安排9月12日停止
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指涉及男男性接觸者的甲型肝炎群組傳播鏈已截斷，個案回落至基線水平，免費接種安排將於9月12日結束。

en.headline: DSE appeal results add one more super top scorer from Yuen Long school
en.dek: A student from Heung Yee Kuk Yuen Long District Secondary School secured seven 5** grades after a successful biology review, lifting the year’s total top scorers to 25 and super top scorers to 12.

zh.headline: 文憑試覆核結果新增一名超級狀元 來自元朗鄉中
zh.dek: 新界鄉議局元朗區中學孫菀青成功覆核生物科後共獲七科5**，今屆狀元增至25人、超級狀元增至12人，已獲港大醫學院錄取。

en.headline: ASD demands urgent lift repairs at Queen Mary Hospital new clinical block
en.dek: Only four of 28 lifts are operating in Clinical Block 1; the Architectural Services Department has ordered the contractor to complete rectification by the fourth quarter and reserved the right to claim damages.

zh.headline: 建築署責成瑪麗醫院新大樓承建商盡早完成升降機執修
zh.dek: 臨床大樓1共28部升降機目前只有4部可用，建築署已責成總承建商及分判商盡快完成執修，預算今年第四季內完成，並保留追究權利。

en.headline: AFCD prosecutes woman over 136 unlicensed dogs at Yuen Long shelter
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department charged a woman under the Rabies Regulation after a raid on a Yuen Long animal shelter found 136 dogs without valid licences.

zh.headline: 漁護署檢控元朗收容所女子 涉無牌畜養136隻狗
zh.dek: 漁護署接市民投訴後突擊檢查元朗一間動物收容所，發現136隻懷疑未領有效牌照的狗隻，已向一名女子提出檢控。

en.headline: Housing Society raises rents 2.85% from October at most rental estates
en.dek: Category A tenants will pay about HK$73 more on average each month and Category B tenants about HK$200 more; the new levels run until September 2028.

zh.headline: 房協出租屋邨十月起加租2.85% 甲乙類平均月租增73至200元
zh.dek: 新租金由10月1日起生效至2028年9月30日，近兩年新入伙四個屋邨不在今次檢討範圍內。

en.headline: Fish raft fire in Sai Kung’s Po Toi O injures man; vessels damaged
en.dek: A blaze at fish rafts near the minibus stop this morning produced explosions and thick smoke; firefighters and a fireboat extinguished it within about 50 minutes.

zh.headline: 西貢布袋澳魚排起火傳爆炸聲 一人手指受傷
zh.dek: 今早布袋澳一號及二號魚排起火，曾傳出爆炸聲及冒出濃煙，消防水陸兩路灌救，約50分鐘救熄，一名六旬男子救火時手指受傷。

en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 19 mainland women in Yuen Long anti-prostitution operation
en.dek: Officers from the Yuen Long Police District Special Duties Squad and the Immigration Department detained the women, aged 21 to 51, for alleged breach of conditions of stay during a joint operation on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 元朗掃黃聯同入境處拘19名內地女子 涉違反逗留條件
zh.dek: 元朗警區特別職務隊聯同入境事務處周二展開行動，以涉嫌違反逗留條件拘捕19名年齡介乎21至51歲的內地女子，全部被扣留調查。

en.headline: Customs and Immigration run cross-department drill at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: About 50 officers from Customs, Immigration, police, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency practised vehicle and passenger clearance procedures, including system faults and reverse exits, ahead…

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸跨部門通關演練 模擬系統故障及倒車離場
zh.dek: 海關、入境處、警務處、衞生署及政府產業署約50人周二在港方口岸區演練人車通關程序，包括查驗系統故障及車輛倒車離開聯合一站式車道等突發情况。

en.headline: Baptist University reviews systems after ransomware group claims breach
en.dek: The university said it is examining IT security and personal data protection following online claims by the group The Gentlemen that credentials linked to about 1,900 accounts may have been compromised.

zh.headline: 浸大檢視系統保安 勒索軟件組織聲稱入侵
zh.dek: 校方表示正密切檢視資訊科技系統及個人資料安全，有平台指約1,900組與浸大網域相關的憑證可能外洩。

en.headline: CFS urges public not to consume two Olitalia olive oil products
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said the Italian pomace olive oils may contain mineral oil hydrocarbons after a Belgian alert; the local distributor has stopped sales and begun a recall.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款Olitalia橄欖油 或含礦物油
zh.dek: 中心指意大利品牌兩款果渣橄欖油可能含芳香族碳氫化合物，分銷商已停售下架並展開回收。

en.headline: HKBU investigating reports of ransomware group and leaked credentials
en.dek: Security platforms listed Hong Kong Baptist University among victims of the group TheGentlemen, with roughly 1,900 sets of credentials reportedly exposed involving staff and student accounts.

zh.headline: 浸大調查勒索軟件組織聲稱入侵及憑證外洩報告
zh.dek: 網絡安全平台列出浸會大學為勒索軟件組織TheGentlemen聲稱受害者，約1,900組與hkbu.edu.hk相關憑證據報外洩，涉及職員及學生帳戶。

en.headline: Shui Pin Wai Estate hit by second power cut within 18 hours
en.dek: CLP Power said temporary cables caused unstable supply affecting about 2,200 households for roughly 30 minutes on Tuesday night; fire services handled lift entrapment reports.

zh.headline: 水邊圍邨18小時內兩度停電 臨時電纜供電不穩
zh.dek: 中電指周二晚臨時電纜線路懷疑供電不穩，影響約2,200戶約半小時；消防接獲困𨋢報告。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as extreme heat continues
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and very hot conditions on Wednesday, with urban highs around 34 degrees Celsius and some New Territories areas still extremely hot.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 今日繼續酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台料星期三大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約34度，新界部分地區仍然極端酷熱。

en.headline: Universal Funeral Parlour limited to partial service after power fault
en.dek: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals said a busbar and fuse failure at the Hung Hom parlour left some floors without full air-conditioning and lighting; full operations are expected to resume on Thursday afternoon.

zh.headline: 寰宇殯儀館電力故障僅限有限度服務 料周四復常
zh.dek: 東華三院指紅磡寰宇殯儀館二樓電表房滙流排及保險絲故障，部分樓層冷氣及照明受影響，殮房正常，預計周四下午全面修復。

en.headline: 72-year-old hiker found dead on Sha Tin trail after three-day search
en.dek: Rescuers located the body of Tam Hing-man on a mountain path in Man Hang, Fo Tan, on Tuesday morning; he had gone missing while hiking on Saturday.

zh.headline: 72歲行山客沙田失蹤三日後尋回遺體
zh.dek: 搜救人員周二上午在火炭蚊坑山路發現譚姓男子倒卧，當場證實死亡；他周六行山時與同伴走失後失聯。

en.headline: Search under way for passenger missing from Shekou sightseeing boat near HZMB
en.dek: Hong Kong marine police, fireboats and a Government Flying Service helicopter joined the search in waters west of Tuen Mun after the man was noticed missing on the return to Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋觀光船疑有乘客墮海 屯門海域搜救中
zh.dek: 深圳蛇口出發的觀光船回程發現一名男乘客失蹤，香港水警、滅火輪及飛行服務隊直升機在屯門后海灣一帶搜索。

en.headline: School flu vaccine outreach switches to electronic consent forms from 17 August
en.dek: Parents can submit consent via the eHealth app by scanning a school-specific QR code, streamlining paperwork for the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme.

zh.headline: 流感疫苗學校外展計劃下周一起推電子同意書
zh.dek: 家長可由8月17日起經醫健通掃描學校專屬二維碼為子女遞交接種同意書，簡化填表及行政程序。

en.headline: Police arrest 10 for dangerous driving after first drone operation on Kwun Tong Bypass
en.dek: Nine men and a woman aged 25 to 51 were detained between 3 and 10 August; officers seized seven private cars and three motorcycles in the East Kowloon operation.

zh.headline: 警首次用無人機打擊觀塘繞道危駕 拘10人扣10車
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部3日至10日行動中，9男1女年齡25至51歲涉危險駕駛被捕，扣留7輛私家車及3輛電單車。

en.headline: 18-month-old in serious condition with influenza A and encephalopathy
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric case; the previously healthy boy remains in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after developing convulsions.

zh.headline: 18個月大男嬰染甲流併發腦病變及敗血性休克 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，男嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。

en.headline: International oil painting exchange exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: The second Hong Kong–Beijing–Moscow–St Petersburg–Paris International Oil Painting Exchange Exhibition runs from 11 to 16 August, featuring more than 240 works by local and overseas artists.

zh.headline: 國際油畫交流大展中央圖書館揭幕
zh.dek: 第二屆香港—北京—莫斯科—聖彼得堡—巴黎國際油畫交流大展今日起至16日在中央圖書館舉行，展出超過240幅本地及海外作品。

en.headline: Privacy watchdog arrests man for alleged doxxing over restaurant debt dispute
en.dek: A 37-year-old wholesale food supplier is suspected of disclosing personal details of a former restaurant operator and consultant online after a payment dispute, the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data…

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署拘男子涉因食肆欠款糾紛起底
zh.dek: 一名37歲凍肉批發商涉嫌在網上披露前餐廳東主及顧問的個人資料，私隱專員公署表示案件源於一宗付款爭議。

en.headline: Taxi collides with police car in Kwai Chung, three injured
en.dek: The taxi driver and two officers reported injuries after the crash at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street on Monday night; all were conscious.

zh.headline: 葵涌的士攔腰撞警車 三人受傷送院
zh.dek: 周一晚葵福路與盛福街交界發生交通意外，的士司機及兩名警員報稱受傷，全部清醒送院，警方正調查成因。

en.headline: Underground cable fault leaves 2,400 Yuen Long households without power
en.dek: CLP Power said a fault at about 4.22am affected Shui Pin Wai Estate and nearby areas; engineers aimed to restore supply by 10am using temporary generators and cables.

zh.headline: 元朗地底電纜故障 水邊圍邨約2400戶停電
zh.dek: 中電指凌晨約4時22分發生故障，影響水邊圍邨及附近用戶，工程人員調動臨時發電機及電纜搶修，料上午10時復電。

en.headline: Labour chief says heat-stress warning thresholds under review after record heat
en.dek: Commissioner for Labour Chris Hui admitted the system failed to escalate beyond amber during the recent extreme temperatures and pledged faster adjustments, possibly within the summer.

zh.headline: 許澤森：工作暑熱警告門檻將檢視 望暑假內完成
zh.dek: 勞工處處長承認近日破紀錄高溫下警告未有升級，自己亦有問號，正聯同天文台研究下調門檻或引入多軌制，冀今個夏天完成。

en.headline: Foreign man injured in knife attack in Lok Ma Chau
en.dek: A 29-year-old man was wounded in the leg by two assailants on Monday night; police are searching for the suspects and have classified the case as wounding.

zh.headline: 落馬洲外籍男子遭刀襲 腿部受傷
zh.dek: 29歲外籍男子周一晚在落馬洲金博路西被兩人持刀襲擊，腿部受傷，清醒送往博愛醫院，案件列傷人，警方正緝捕疑犯。

en.headline: Michelle Wai wins Best Actress at Hundred Flowers Awards for The Last Dance
en.dek: The Hong Kong actress took the prize in Beijing on Monday for her role in the funeral-industry drama, ahead of mainland competitors.

zh.headline: 衛詩雅憑《破·地獄》奪百花獎最佳女主角
zh.dek: 香港女演員衛詩雅周一在北京第38屆大眾電影百花獎憑本地電影《破·地獄》奪最佳女主角，票數領先內地對手。

en.headline: Japanese tourist robbed of HK$15,000 in Tsim Sha Tsui hotel room
en.dek: A 19-year-old woman was attacked after opening her door at The Imperial Hotel on Monday night; the suspect fled and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒店日籍女遊客遭搶 損失1.5萬元
zh.dek: 19歲日本女子周一晚在帝豪酒店房門被襲，頸部受傷，約1.5萬元現金被搶，疑犯逃走，暫無人被捕。
